📚This farm is easy to build and can produce +4500 ~ +12000 Gunpowder Per Hour ! 
📚This farm is so simple and I highly recommend this farm for beginners, it takes about 1 - 3 hours to build.
📚Important : Best Difficulty [ Hard ] - Render Distance [ 6 - 8 ] - Simulation Distance [ 6 - 7 ] - Best Location for this farm [ High heights locations, Deep Ocean Biomes[All-Types], Spawn-Proofed areas and Perimeter - Best Mode ( With Sword ) ]
📚You can use looting enchantment to get higher rates from this farm.
📚If you want to build this farm on the land be sure to start the building at y = 240 and if you want to build this farm on top of the ocean you can start the building from y = 140.
📚In this design, you can add more layers but it's not efficient 2 layers are the recommended number of layers.
